routine.title: Note di rilascio da git
routine.description: Writes Italian release notes for the commits between two refs of a local repository, grouped by feature and fix.

steps.title: Scrivi le note
steps.prompt:
Write release notes for the repository at {{repoPath}}, for the commits in {{from}}..{{to}}.

Read the commits with git log (subject and body; skip merge commits). Group them as Novità (feat), Correzioni (fix) and Altro; one line per change, in plain Italian for users, without commit hashes or file names. Drop pure refactors, tests and CI changes.

Save the notes as evidence/release-notes.md in your step folder. Done = the file exists and the summary says how many changes are in each group. If the range is empty or a ref does not exist, the step failed: say which ref.
